key.name: erase-word-keybinding
key.description: Pressed while a dictation session is recording, erases the last visible transcribed/typed word (temporary until new speech makes it permanent). Only active while recording; the extension adds and removes this binding dynamically so the key behaves normally the rest of the time.

key.name: undo-erase-keybinding
key.summary: Restore last erased word while dictating
key.description: Pressed while a dictation session is recording, restores the last word erased with the erase-word-keybinding, if nothing has been spoken since. Only active while recording.
